name: Carl
description: A smooth, balanced Brazilian espresso with chocolate depth and a subtle plum sweetness. A versatile everyday coffee that works beautifully both black and with milk.

name: Yirgacheffe Kochere
description: Delicate and tea-like. Expect bergamot, white peach, and a clean finish. Perfect for a slow morning pour-over.

name: Signature Blend
description: Roasted right here in Düsseldorf. A balanced medium roast with caramel, hazelnut, and a smooth finish — works beautifully as espresso or filter.

name: Finca El Suelo
description: From the legendary Oslo roaster. Stone fruit, honey sweetness, and a silky body. Worth every cent.

name: Red Brick Espresso
description: The gold standard espresso blend from London. Rich, sweet, and consistent — works with milk or straight.

name: Colombia La Palma
description: Barcelona's finest brings a stunning Colombian lot — milk chocolate, brown sugar, and a gentle citrus brightness.
